title: Does Norfolk prevent litter, or only pick it up?
summary: Norfolk and Keep Norfolk Beautiful run some prevention (education, free cigarette receptacles, campaigns, a state litter-prevention grant, and the 2022 Litterati study meant to test prevention on commercial corridors). But prevention is small beside cleanup, no results of the 2022 prevention test were found, Norfolk has not adopted the 5-cent bag tax, and no record was found of enforcing the state rule requiring litter receptacles at gas stations, fast-food restaurants and shopping centers.

what_would_help.text: Adopt Virginia's 5-cent bag tax; its revenue is earmarked for litter and pollution work.
Enforce the state receptacle rule at gas stations, fast-food restaurants and shopping centers on the hotspot corridors.
Put serviced cigarette receptacles at business entrances and the busiest bus stops, and measure butt counts before and after.
Publish the results of the 2022 Litterati prevention study and resume the Litter Index, last published for 2019.
